meta.title: Cortx - Study smarter. Remember longer.
meta.description: Cortx helps you memorize anything using flashcards and spaced repetition. Turn your notes into lasting knowledge and review them at the perfect time.

hero.title:
Study smarter.
Remember longer.
hero.subtitle: Cortx helps you memorize anything using flashcards and spaced repetition. Turn your notes into lasting knowledge and review them at the perfect time.

features.title: The essential tool to make knowledge stick

flashcards.title: Smart flashcards
flashcards.description: Create flashcards in seconds and organize them into collections for any subject. Add images, formatted text, lists, or code to make your cards clearer and more effective.

repetition.title: Spaced repetition learning
repetition.description: Review your cards at the right moment using a proven memory method based on spaced repetition. Cortx automatically schedules your reviews and sends daily reminders so you never forget to study.

statistics.title: Advanced statistics
statistics.description: Understand your learning with detailed insights into your progress, habits, and memory strength. Track review activity, card distribution, study consistency, and see exactly how your knowledge evolves over time.

ai.title: AI-powered suggestions
ai.description: Cortx analyzes your existing cards and automatically suggests new ones to expand your knowledge. One tap to add, one to skip — so the app becomes not just a review tool, but a way to discover and learn things you didn't know yet.

widget.title: Home screen widget
widget.description: Add a widget to your home screen and let your cards come to you. A random flashcard is displayed and refreshes every minute, turning idle moments into effortless micro-reviews without even opening the app.

screenshots.title: A method built for long-term retention
screenshots.subtitle: An intelligent review system brings each card back right when your memory needs it.

editor.address: The professional address is available upon request.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.description: The application data is hosted by Supabase, a secure cloud service provider based in Europe and the United States.
hosting.privacy: The stored information is exclusively related to the use of the application and is neither shared nor sold to third parties.

personalData.title: Personal Data
personalData.collection: The Cortx app only collects data strictly necessary for its proper functioning (cards, progress, preferences).
personalData.ads: No data is used for advertising purposes.
personalData.deletion: You can request the deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.description: To improve the application, we use the following trusted services:
thirdPartyServices.sentry: Sentry: Error monitoring and crash reporting
thirdPartyServices.posthog: PostHog: Anonymous usage analytics (session recording disabled)
thirdPartyServices.revenuecat: RevenueCat: Subscription and in-app purchase management
thirdPartyServices.web3forms: Web3Forms: Contact form handling for bug reports and feature requests

permissions.title: Permissions and Access
permissions.description: The app may request the following permissions:
permissions.photos: Photos/Camera: Only when you choose to add images to your flashcards
permissions.notifications: Notifications: To send daily review reminders (optional)

distribution.title: Distribution Platforms
distribution.platforms: The application is distributed through the App Store (Apple) and Google Play Store (Android).
distribution.policies: These platforms may, on their end, collect certain technical data in accordance with their own privacy policies.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.copyright: All content of the Cortx app (texts, visuals, features) is protected by copyright.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.version: The application is available in a free version with paid options.
termsOfUse.compliance: The user agrees to respectful use in accordance with French legislation.
